query:
select exists (
             select 1
               from app_sessions a
               join sessions s on s.id = a.parent_session_id
               join users u on u.id = s.user_id
              where a.secret_sha256 = $1
                and a.app_id = $2
                and a.expires_at > now()
                and s.revoked_at is null
                and s.expires_at > now()
                and u.deleted_at is null
           ) as "live!"
